title: Calvin and Hobbes and the price of integrity
summary: A literary analysis exploring Bill Watterson's artistic integrity through the lens of Calvin and Hobbes, examining how the comic strip's creator refused commercial merchandising and maintained creative control, and what price Watterson paid for maintaining his principles.
problem_solved: Explores the philosophical tension between artistic integrity and commercial success through the enduring legacy of Calvin and Hobbes
why_valuable: Offers thoughtful cultural commentary on maintaining creative principles in an era of commercialization, resonating with readers who value authenticity over profit
